authorization: Read-only research and scoped local evidence writes. No trades, publication, external messaging or monitoring.
proxy_definition: CFO minus cash capex minus stock compensation addback minus distributions to noncontrolling owners when applicable. An author screen, not GAAP, company FCF or a complete valuation.
proxy_limits: Working-capital and tax timing can distort TTM; subtract all capex conservatively and distinguish transitory from recurring cash.
SBC deduction is an economic dilution reserve approximation; do not also deduct it from EPS that already includes SBC.
Retirement of shares belongs in future per-share earnings/cash, not as an additional yield on top of already modeled share reduction.
Company acquisitions, debt principal and material deferred obligations can compete with cash distributions.
Quoted prices are observed October12 closes; reported shares/balances have earlier stated dates.

HCA.name: HCA Healthcare

latest_balance.note: Book debt used consistently with company liquidity disclosure; total includes debt issuance discounts. Unused credit availability is borrowing capacity, not cash.

observations.fact: Q2 headline sales grew8.7%, but Florida recognition includes prior-period revenue and expense.
Q2 company estimated payer-mix pretax harm approximately offset by incremental Medicaid benefit. The administrative/tax-credit loss is not a one-off accounting item.
Patient need rises but insured reimbursement quality erodes; surgeries decline while uninsured volume grows.
Headline salaries/revenue ratio partly benefits from retroactive revenue; direct unit labor data is more useful.
Concentration magnifies state payer-policy sensitivity.
Cash proxy must remove distributions to minority owners; CFO includes their earnings. 2025 repurchases exceed cash after capex/SBC/NCI.
observations.note: Do not add repurchase yield on top of EPS growth; new debt funded part of capital return.

observations.fact: Q2 GAAP-to-adjusted EPS subtracts facility gains; adjusted results retain SBC and Medicaid recognition.

CMS February2 preliminary letter limits state-directed payments and phases down qualifying grandfathered programs for rating periods beginning2028. This is not proof that all HCA programs fall at one date.
observations.note: The CMS letter is preliminary guidance pending rulemaking; company acknowledges uncertain program approval/timing. Keep the policy downside inside the two-year horizon.

HCA.screen_judgment: Rank3: reject as one of the four current-price longs. Durable scale does not overcome current payer-mix deterioration, backward-looking Medicaid recognition, debt-funded capital returns and roughly5% owner cash yield at$458.60. A lower entry or demonstrated organic operating recovery would change the decision.
